verified_facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Tokyo, steps from the Akasaka Prince Classic House and directly connected to the subway station.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our luxury hotel in downtown Tokyo is superbly located just steps from the iconic Akasaka Prince Classic House, directly connected to the subway station

verified_facts.text: Guests arrive in a soaring Sky Lobby with abundant natural light.
verified_facts.excerpt: The moment you step into our soaring Sky Lobby, with its abundant natural light

verified_facts.text: The hotel displays more than 100 artworks based on the concept of 'Levitation', chosen because it is a high-rise hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: features numerous artworks based on the concept of "Levitation," as this is a high-rise hotel. More than 100 pieces of art can be appreciated as if you are in an art gallery.

verified_facts.text: Tokyo Garden Terrace Kioicho, where the hotel is situated, has 9 contemporary art pieces installed.
verified_facts.excerpt: At Tokyo Garden Terrace Kioicho, where this hotel is situated, 9 contemporary art pieces are installed

verified_facts.text: About 400 years ago, in the Edo period, residences of the Kishu Tokugawa, Owari Tokugawa and Hikone Ii families stood in Kioicho, and the name Kioicho comes from the initials of these families.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thus the name "Kioicho" originated from the initials of these families.

verified_facts.text: The indoor swimming pool is on the 30th floor, with poolside deck chairs facing the window so guests can look over the landscape while lying down.
verified_facts.excerpt: This swimming pool is located on the 30th floor, and it looks like the surface of the swimming pool water blends into the city center sky. Deck chairs are installed at the poolside facing the window

verified_facts.text: SPA KIOI by SWISS PERFECTION offers a range of treatments, a lap pool and a couple's suite with dramatic views.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a range of treatments, a lap pool, and a couple's suite with dramatic views, SPA KIOI by SWISS PERFECTION pampers you.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a spa, an indoor pool and a heated public bath.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our spa, indoor pool, and heated public bath offer a restorative retreat

verified_facts.text: The gym looks over the city center and is equipped with Technogym equipment from Italy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Run in refreshing sunlight while overlooking the changing view of the bustling city center. You can work out in the liberating and luxurious space equipped with the latest equipment of Technogym, Italy.

verified_facts.text: The rooms reflect the design concept 'Levitation'.
verified_facts.excerpt: The artistic room reflecting the design concept "Levitation" will stage your stay

verified_facts.text: In the Deluxe King, the window is set in an alcove with a daybed built along it.
verified_facts.excerpt: Like a shadow box, the window is encased like an alcove with a daybed built along the window, allowing guests to sit—if not hover—in the sky.

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms are enclosed in glass walls that can be made clear or opaque at the push of a button, and include separate tubs and standup showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Even the bathroom keeps things airy, enclosed in glass walls that, just like the sky, can be clear or opaque (depending on which button you push).

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms include separate tubs and standup showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: include separate tubs and standup showers that still get natural daylight thanks to the glass walls

verified_facts.text: A button in the room lets fresh air circulate from outside.
verified_facts.excerpt: Another button allows fresh air to circulate from outside.

verified_facts.text: Sky Gallery Lounge Levita is a cocktail bar with expansive city views and glass art that resembles a waterfall.
verified_facts.excerpt: The bar features glass art that resembles a waterfall and large windows that provide sweeping views.

verified_facts.text: WASHOKU SOUTEN serves modern Japanese cuisine, including sushi and teppanyaki, in a crystal-style interior.
verified_facts.excerpt: serves modern Japanese cuisine, including sushi and teppanyaki. Conveying the freshness of seasonal ingredients, customers sample fantastic flavors in an innovative, crystal-style interior.

verified_facts.text: All-Day Dining OASIS GARDEN has city views and a 'hanging garden' concept.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy all-day dining at our downtown Tokyo restaurant with views of the city and a “hanging garden” concept at OASIS GARDEN.

verified_facts.text: The surrounding Nagatacho area is mostly new builds and business towers, but it is prime territory for accessing the rest of the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Nagatacho area is mostly polished off with new builds and business towers, but it’s prime territory for accessing the rest of the city.

verified_facts.text: Wi-Fi is free throughout the entire hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wi-Fi is free throughout the entire hotel.

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets Not Allowed

verified_facts.text: THE SHOP at KIOI offers original hotel products and seasonal items.
verified_facts.excerpt: We offer a large selection of original hotel products and seasonal items.

verified_facts.text: Elevators open onto a mezzanine overlooking the two-floor Sky Gallery Lounge Levita, where illuminated sculptural walls frame floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elevators open into a mezzanine overlooking the two-floor Sky Gallery Lounge Levita, where illuminated, sculptural walls, which look like waves, frame a series of floor-to-ceiling windows
